# Preventive Lifestyle Medicine & Health Assessment Platform

> An interactive evidence-informed preventive cardiology, metabolic health, and lifestyle medicine platform based on circadian biology, Nobel-prize winning autophagy science, and South Asian cardiovascular risk research.

## Multi-Page Architecture & Clean Endpoints

The platform is structured into clean static endpoints:

1. **Home (`/`)**: `https://health.bongshai.com/`
   - Executive answer-first summary, clinical authority credentials, 6-pillar risk assessment, personalized lifestyle prescription, and core metabolic FAQ.
2. **Clinical Lab Decoder & TOFI Indices (`/lab-decoder/`)**: `https://health.bongshai.com/lab-decoder/`
   - Waist-to-Height Ratio (WHtR), Triglyceride-to-HDL ratio (TG/HDL), and TyG index alongside 7-biomarker traffic-light clinical evaluator.
3. **Cooking Oil Health Matrix (`/cooking-oils/`)**: `https://health.bongshai.com/cooking-oils/`
   - Cold-pressed unrefined oils (Mustard, Coconut, Ghee, Olive) vs industrial seed oils (Soybean, Palm) — smoke points and oxidative stability.
4. **Egg & Cholesterol Science (`/eggs/`)**: `https://health.bongshai.com/eggs/`
   - Whole-egg dietary cholesterol evidence, choline & lutein benefits, and daily egg nutrition calculator.
5. **Chronic Disease Reversal Protocols (`/disease-reversal/`)**: `https://health.bongshai.com/disease-reversal/`
   - 4-tab clinical reversal protocols for Type 2 Diabetes, Hypertension, NAFLD / Fatty Liver, and Chronic Stress.
6. **Breathing & HRV Pacer (`/breathing/`)**: `https://health.bongshai.com/breathing/`
   - Heart-mind neurocardiology guidance merged with interactive Vagus Nerve Breathing Pacer (4-7-8, Box Breathing, 5.5s resonance bubble).
7. **Medical Mythbusters (`/mythbusters/`)**: `https://health.bongshai.com/mythbusters/`
   - Evidence-based debunking of 5 critical metabolic myths (egg yolks, vegetable oils, dietary fat, chronic medication, breakfast timing).
8. **Intermittent Fasting & Autophagy Tracker (`/fasting/`)**: `https://health.bongshai.com/fasting/`
   - Real-time biological phase tracker (glycogen depletion, ketosis, peak autophagy, insulin sensitivity, stem cell renewal).
9. **Desi Nutrition Plate Builder (`/plate-builder/`)**: `https://health.bongshai.com/plate-builder/`
   - Interactive 50% vegetables, 25% protein, 25% complex carbs plate designer and localized 7-day budget meal plans.
10. **Metabolic Habit Tracker (`/habit-tracker/`)**: `https://health.bongshai.com/habit-tracker/`
    - Daily 6-pillar compliance checklist, streak counter, progress bar, and 7-day consistency dot matrix.
11. **Doctor Health Passport (`/doctor-passport/`)**: `https://health.bongshai.com/doctor-passport/`
    - Consolidated clinical discussion summary, cross-page metabolic metrics, and 5 targeted physician discussion questions for deprescribing.

## Core Medical & Lifestyle Principles

1. **Root-Cause Resolution Over Symptom Suppression**: Chronic non-communicable diseases (type-2 diabetes, hypertension, dyslipidemia, coronary artery disease, non-alcoholic fatty liver) are predominantly lifestyle and metabolic disorders driven by chronic hyperinsulinemia, visceral adiposity, and endothelial inflammation rather than inevitable genetic fate.
2. **Whole Food Anti-Inflammatory Nutrition**: Eliminate added sugars, refined carbohydrates, and chemically processed industrial seed oils (polyunsaturated soybean/canola/palm oils). Prioritize indigenous greens, seasonal fish, cold-pressed mustard oil (Kachi Ghani), whole eggs with yolk, colorful raw salads, and unrefined whole grains.
3. **Autophagy & Intermittent Fasting (14–16h Window)**: Allow the digestive tract a daily biological rest window of 14 to 16 hours (early dinner completed by 8:00 PM, delayed breakfast at 10:00 AM) to stimulate cellular lysosomal recycling (autophagy), glycogen clearance, and pancreatic beta-cell restoration.
4. **Circadian Rhythm Restoration & Restful Sleep**: Sleeping before 10:30 PM in a dark environment and waking with natural morning sunlight optimizes melatonin synthesis, downregulates cortisol, and drives deep cellular detox.
5. **Daily Aerobic Movement & Nitric Oxide Synthesis**: Minimum 40 to 60 minutes of brisk walking outdoors with sunlight exposure enhances GLUT-4 glucose disposal, mitochondrial density, and vascular endothelial nitric oxide generation.
6. **Neuro-Cardiovascular Modulation & Vagal Stimulation**: Chronic psychological stress surges catecholamines and damages arterial walls. Daily slow rhythmic breathing (4-7-8, box breathing, 5.5s resonance) stimulates the parasympathetic vagus nerve, immediately decelerating heart rate and attenuating arterial hypertension.
7. **South Asian TOFI (Thin-Outside-Fat-Inside) Phenotype Awareness**: Standard BMI drastically underestimates risk in South Asians. Waist-to-Height Ratio (WHtR ≥ 0.50), Triglyceride-to-HDL ratio (TG/HDL > 2.0), and Triglyceride-Glucose index (TyG > 8.5) serve as vital clinical surrogates for visceral adipose accumulation and occult insulin resistance.

## WebMCP Interactive Agent Actions

This platform exposes machine-readable WebMCP actions accessible via standard DOM bindings (`data-mcp-action`):

### Global Actions (Available on all pages)
- `toggle_language`: Toggles between Bengali (`bn`) and English (`en`).
- `toggle_theme`: Toggles between Light and Dark mode.
- `open_doctor_passport`: Navigates / scrolls to the Doctor Health Passport.

### Page-Specific Actions
- **On `/` (Home)**:
  - `calculate_health_risk`: Calculates metabolic risk tier and resilience score.
  - `reset_assessment`: Resets the primary risk evaluation form.
  - `export_health_report`: Opens the print dialog scoped to the personalized lifestyle prescription card.
- **On `/lab-decoder/`**:
  - `calculate_insulin_resistance`: Calculates WHtR, TG/HDL ratio, and TyG index with clinical verdict.
  - `decode_biomarkers`: Analyzes the 7 critical blood biomarkers with green/yellow/red traffic light advice.
- **On `/cooking-oils/`**:
  - `filter_oil_type`: Filters the cooking-oil matrix (`all`, `safe`, `danger`).
- **On `/eggs/`**:
  - `calculate_egg_protein`: Recomputes the whole-egg nutrition calculator for the selected egg count.
- **On `/disease-reversal/`**:
  - `filter_health_topics`: Switches the disease-reversal explorer tab (`diabetes`, `hypertension`, `fattyliver`, `stress`).
- **On `/breathing/`**:
  - `start_breathing_exercise`: Starts the 2-minute cardiac-coherence breathing timer.
  - `reset_breathing_exercise`: Resets that 2-minute breathing timer.
  - `trigger_breathing_session`: Starts or pauses the vagus pacer breathing session.
  - `toggle_breathing_chime`: Toggles Web Audio API chime sound on phase transitions.
- **On `/mythbusters/`**:
  - `toggle_myth_item`: Expands or collapses a health-mythbuster accordion entry.
- **On `/fasting/`**:
  - `set_fast_start_now`: Sets fasting start timestamp to current time and initializes timer.
  - `toggle_fasting_timer`: Toggles active timer execution for intermittent fasting.
  - `reset_fasting_timer`: Resets the fasting timer to initial state.
- **On `/habit-tracker/`**:
  - `log_daily_habits`: Saves daily 6-pillar habit completion and increments unbroken streak.
- **On `/doctor-passport/`**:
  - `export_doctor_discussion_sheet`: Triggers print dialog scoped to the single-page doctor discussion sheet.
